title: Pin correct-contract failures with it.fails and close pending tasks before mission finish
summary: Environment-dependent defects can be reproduced deterministically by driving real dispatch paths through synthetic scope-envelope fixtures, and a correct-but-unimplemented contract should stay red under it.fails until the fix lands; separately, recorded evidence does not complete pending mission tasks — task status must be updated and re-verified before finish.
hint_triggers: MSN-CLI-RELIABILITY-20261031 reproduced an environment-dependent credential-binding failure deterministically by driving the real dispatch path through synthetic withCoordinationRoot/withScopeEnvelope/runInExecutionScope fixtures, and kept the correct contract red as it.fails until the implementing ticket arrived. The same mission recorded evidence while finish still reported pending tasks: inspect NEXT_TASKS.json status, close tasks through the mission_controller task-completion path for direct work, then repeat verification before invoking finish.
